args.subject: Table reservation request for 12 people
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I am writing to request a table for 12 people next Friday. Could you please let me know your availability and suggest suitable time slots for a party of our size?

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am contacting on behalf of Blue Sparrow Tech.

Please feel free to contact me at emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com or by phone at 327-420-4923 to confirm the reservation details.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
